_schema: Each entry: {id, status, blocker, impact, revisit (milestone-when-revisit), evidence (note/ADR path)}; optional workaround/mitigation, milestone (discovered). Deferrals are honesty, not silence (GOAL.md). Runtime-visible on the M8 dashboard deferral registry.

deferred.revisit: tier-(b/c) suite that exercises driver-network div-by-zero / domain-error paths
deferred.blocker: WebAssembly has no floating-point exception status register; emscripten's <fenv.h> defines FE_ALL_EXCEPT 0 and omits FE_DIVBYZERO/FE_INVALID, so fetestexcept() always returns 0.
deferred.impact: BLI_expr_pylike_eval div-by-zero / domain-error detection is a no-op on wasm: expressions that divide by zero or take sqrt/pow of a domain error return EXPR_PYLIKE_SUCCESS instead of _DIV_BY_ZERO / _MATH_ERROR. 9 blenlib gtests fail on wasm (expr_pylike.Error_DivZero1-3, Error_SqrtDomain1-2, Error_PowDomain1-2, Error_Mixed1-2); all pass natively.
deferred.workaround: A source-level explicit divide/NaN check in expr_pylike_eval would restore parity without the hardware register; deferred until a tier-(b/c) suite exercises driver-network error paths. Tracked in patches/0004 + notes/m1-blenlib.md Class 2.

deferred.revisit: m2b — relaxed wasm tolerance or a libm review
deferred.blocker: Blender's vector/matrix math is float32; the wasm libm (acosf/sqrtf/etc.) rounds differently from native arm64, so last-ULP numeric divergences appear versus the native oracle.
deferred.impact: 3 m2b CORE suites diverge (green on native, fail on wasm): script_pyapi_mathutils test_orthogonal (bl_pyapi_mathutils.py:666, 1.570796251296997 != 1.5707963267948966, Δ7.5e-08, places=7); script_pyapi_bmesh (failures=2: 651.346363723278 != 651.346448 Δ8.4e-05 + one set-membership diff); bl_constraints (Object-Solver matrix 0.20000046 != 0.19999939 Δ1.07e-06 at [1][3]).
deferred.workaround: Relax the wasm tier-b tolerance for these numeric asserts, or review the specific libm calls; a genuine cross-platform-precision datum, not a correctness bug.

deferred.revisit: structural fix is probe-gated (wasm64 -sMEMORY64 vs wasm32 pointer interning), likely post-M4 / pre-launch; LAUNCH.md drag-drop depends on it landing before M8
deferred.blocker: Reading 64-bit .blend files on wasm32 truncates 8-byte block addresses into 4 bytes assuming 8-byte alignment (>>3 at BLO_core_bhead.hh:124 / dna_genfile.cc:929). Real writers emit sub-8-aligned adjacent DATA blocks whose distinct addresses then collide → duplicate map insert (loud abort) or mis-resolved pointer fields (silent corruption). Data-dependent: most files pass, some break.
deferred.impact: Affected m2b suites reclassify to blocked-by-ADR-004 (e.g. bl_node_structure_type_inference: 'Blendfile corruption: Invalid, or multiple bhead with same old address value' -> Aborted). Launch drag-drop of arbitrary user .blend cannot ship on wasm32 as-is.
deferred.mitigation: ADR-004 Decision 1: a loud collision detector (patch 0017, wasm32-only #ifdef) at BHead-index build time refuses a colliding read with an explicit error naming the ADR — converts silent corruption into a deterministic user-visible failure, zero behavior change for the non-colliding majority. Detector active; this is the safety net, not the fix.

deferred.revisit: M3 T9 texture integration — emulate, or confirm no shipping shader needs snorm16
deferred.blocker: WebGPU/Dawn exposes 16-bit UNORM formats (Unorm16TextureFormats feature) but has NO 16-bit SNORM support at this pin: RGBA16Snorm/R16Snorm/RG16Snorm enumerators exist in webgpu_cpp.h yet no FeatureName enables them, so CreateTexture fails validation. Metal supports MTLPixelFormatRGBA16Snorm — this is a Dawn/WebGPU-surface gap, not hardware.
deferred.impact: 4 of 63 Blender texture formats unsupported: SNORM_16, SNORM_16_16, SNORM_16_16_16, SNORM_16_16_16_16. The other 59 create live and 50/50 color formats round-trip byte-exact on Dawn/Metal.
deferred.workaround: Emulate: (1) store as RGBA16Uint/Unorm + shader remap snorm=value/32767.0 (exact over [-1,1]); or (2) promote to RGBA16Float (lossy at ULP). Blender uses snorm16 rarely (mostly normal/vector textures).

deferred.revisit: M5/M6 — wgpu_batch point-draw expansion + BSL preprocessor prologue (UI/overlay dots, keyframes, particles, edit-mode verts)
deferred.blocker: WebGPU points are always 1px; WGSL has no gl_PointSize builtin and no gl_PointCoord. Every GPU_PRIM_POINTS shader that writes gl_PointSize must be rewritten to draw an instanced quad per point.
deferred.impact: ~23 shaders affected: 8 in gpu/shaders/ (2D/3D point uniform/varying-size AA, keyframe_shape) + ~15 in draw/engines/overlay/shaders/ (loose verts, particles, edit-mode dots).
deferred.workaround: Mechanically-specified R1-R4 instanced-quad rewrite; the prototype compiles through the real T7 chain (shaderc->Tint->WGSL) and renders pixel-accurate 1/5/9px point coverage on live Dawn/Metal. Recommended placement is codegen-level (wgpu_batch draw expansion + preprocessor prologue), mirroring Blender's wide-line solution — zero upstream shader edits.

deferred.blocker: Browser IME is asynchronous (compositionstart/update/end events); wiring dead-keys / composition needs mapping to GHOST_kEventImeComposition* + GHOST_TEventImeData.
deferred.impact: IME / dead-key composition input path not implemented in the custom GHOST-web backend; the Infrom-IME capability is off. Direct key input is unaffected.
deferred.workaround: Add the compositionstart/update/end -> GHOST_kEventImeComposition* bridge when a locale/IME-dependent workflow is in scope.

deferred.revisit: pending the hunt's outcome — one instrumented build + a ~150-run background hunt to separate race vs uninitialized-read (fix is copy-on-eval/tree-lock isolation if race, zero-init the reused socket field if uninit)
deferred.blocker: Non-deterministic (~1.4%, ~1 in 70): after the node-group ungroup operator on the threaded wasm profile (-sPROXY_TO_PTHREAD + TBB), a ShaderNodeValue proxy node's output 'Value' socket intermittently resolves to NodeSocketUndefined instead of NodeSocketFloat. Deterministic + correct on the native oracle and on the direct-add control (both wasm and native). Leading hypotheses: a data race (GN eval on TBB workers concurrent with the next operator's tree mutation) or an uninitialized read of a freed-then-reused bNodeSocket field.
deferred.impact: bl_node_copy_operators test_ungroup_proxy_nodes flakes (bl_node_copy_operators.py:426, 'NodeSocketUndefined' != 'NodeSocketFloat', x4 together). A node-system/threading heisenbug, not a one-line port-class fix — STOP disposition per the fix gate.
deferred.resolution: CONFIRMED-FIXED-BY-f7ec391 (shared OIIO ustring TableRep root cause; 0/150 instrumented hunt on fixed build; commit 184035c)

deferred.blocker: Node clipboard copy writes to a SHARED copybuffer temp path (node_copybuffer_filepath_get, clipboard.cc:48). Concurrent/multi-context processes collide on that path so write_as_copypaste_buffer returns false and node_clipboard_copy_exec hits BLI_assert (clipboard.cc:241, 'marked unreachable').
deferred.impact: Harmless for the sequential m2b gate; a real hazard for any concurrent/multi-context wasm build (browser multi-tab), where two contexts sharing the temp path abort on clipboard copy.
deferred.workaround: Give each context (tab/window) its own copybuffer path.

deferred.revisit: M2.6 — re-enable per actual tier-b suite need (harvest the Hacl hashlib archives; re-add sqlite3/decimal/etc. with proper deps)
deferred.blocker: The browser CPython 3.13.13 target links without several optional C-extension modules whose only unmet deps are external/companion libs absent from the mono-wasm link: hashlib backends (_md5/_sha1/_sha2/_sha3/_blake2 — CPython's per-algorithm Hacl archives), _multiprocessing (no fork/exec in a single wasm module), and (disabled for a self-contained libpython) _sqlite3/_bz2/_decimal/pyexpat/_elementtree.; _ctypes (libffi) absent — now the sole blocker for script_load_addons/modules (numpy no longer blocks, 2026-08-05)
deferred.impact: import hashlib during bpy startup logs ~28 'unsupported hash type' tracebacks then degrades gracefully (module-level try/except); _multiprocessing -> one ModuleNotFoundError during bpy app setup. Both non-fatal — import bpy + operators boot green. Blocks the AMBER m2b suites script_disk_file_hash_service_test (needs sqlite3) and any tier-b suite that actually computes a hash.
deferred.workaround: decimal falls back to pure-python _pydecimal; re-harvest the Hacl SHA archives + re-enable modules with real deps at M2.6 when a suite needs them; multiprocessing is not usable in a single wasm module regardless.

deferred.revisit: post-launch — needs WebGPU hardware ray tracing / bindless (not available); launch ships Cycles-CPU small scenes only
deferred.blocker: No WebGPU hardware ray tracing / bindless resources, so Cycles-GPU final rendering cannot be ported. Cycles-GPU device paths forced OFF (ledger/deps.json forced_off cycles_gpu_devices/embree).
deferred.impact: Cycles final GPU rendering is out of scope for launch. Launch tier includes Cycles-CPU small scenes (M6) only.

deferred.revisit: post-launch — needs a JIT (unavailable in the browser sandbox)
deferred.blocker: Open Shading Language needs LLVM JIT, which the browser sandbox does not permit. LLVM/OSL forced OFF (ledger/deps.json forced_off llvm/cycles_osl).
deferred.impact: OSL shaders unsupported. Not in the launch tier.

deferred.blocker: Mantaflow (fluid/smoke) is not ported; MOD_FLUID forced OFF (ledger/deps.json forced_off mod_fluid).
deferred.impact: Fluid/smoke simulation unsupported. Not in the launch tier.

deferred.revisit: post-launch — coupled to the wasm64/Memory64 decision (see ADR-004 Decision 3)
deferred.blocker: Scenes above ~16 GB exceed the Memory64 addressing cap for the wasm build.
deferred.impact: >16 GB scenes will not load. The overwhelming majority of scenes are far under this cap.

deferred.blocker: OS-shell affordances (spawning external processes, arbitrary filesystem access outside the sandbox, native file dialogs beyond FSA) are unavailable in the browser sandbox.
deferred.impact: Features depending on OS-shell affordances are unsupported; file access is via WasmFS/OPFS + the File System Access API (M7).

deferred.blocker: OpenVDB not built for wasm (WITH_OPENVDB OFF)

deferred.impact: bl_multires suite; bl_sculpt_brushes (multires_reshape_util.cc:118 needs real subdiv — reclassified 2026-08-05, was essentials-genuine)
